{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Jev Nerran''' was an individual who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Nerran was a neighbor and family friend of [[Jobal Naberrie/Legends|Jobal]] and [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]] of [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]], who lived in the same district in Theed as Nerran. The Naberrie's eldest [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and her [[Youngling|children]], [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], regularly visited Jobal and Ruwee.<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|105|NAB 7-8|Sola Naberrie}}</ref> During their trips, they would also visit Nerran,<ref name="Pooja Databank">{{DB|character|poojanaberrie|Naberrie, Pooja}}</ref> spending a great deal of [[Time/Legends|time]] with them and other family friends.<ref name="Fact File" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They're eating at Jev Narran's house later, Mom. They just had a snack. They'll be fine.|Sola Naberrie, in the screenplay of ''Attack of the Clones''|<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>}}
Jev Nerran was created for the screenplay of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], written by [[George Lucas]]. The character did not appear in the finished film or any other adaptations but was included, with their surname spelt as "Narran," in the version of the screenplay published in the book ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]'',<ref name="Art" /> released on [[April 23]], [[2002]],<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/release/publish/news20020207.html|text=Book Preview: The Art of Episode II}}</ref> prior to the film's premiere on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> In it, Sola Naberrie tells her mother that her children are eating at Narran's house shortly after the arrival of her sister, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at the [[Naberrie family home]].<ref name="Art" /> Nerran, with the associated spelling, was then mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entries for Ryoo and Pooja Naberrie,<ref name="Pooja Databank" /> which were published on [[October 23]], 2002.<ref name="DBDates">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/10/news20021023.html|text=Episode II: DVD Undelete}}</ref>
